feedback: This candidate changes one field from the best raced design, iteration 5 (kd 0.7, scored 497.55). It sets controller.kd to 0.9 and keeps base_speed 1.1, kp 1.6, ki 0, last_direction, the sensor_weights, and the iteration 3 and 5 geometry (x -0.06 to +0.06 in 0.03 m steps, y 0.05, size 0.012). The evidence supports a single step further in damping. In iteration 3 (kd 0.5) the s-bend had steering_oscillation 0.309 and max_error 0.0598 m. In iteration 5 (kd 0.7) the oval stayed at 20/20 with steering_oscillation 0.183, and the s-bend improved to 5/20 finishes with max_error 0.060 m. Changing speed (iterations 4 and 1 to 3) did not clear the bend limit, which points to overshoot as the limit. The geometry must not change: iteration 2 (sensor spacing 0.04 m, y 0.07) scored 62.76 with 2.8 line-loss events on the oval. Nothing in the candidate is outside the contract, and it is a clean single-variable test of the best design, so it is worth racing now rather than spending two action runs on a revision. Next race reading: if the oval drops below 20/20 or its steering_oscillation rises well above 0.18, the damping is too high for the straights, so return kd to 0.7 and test kp 1.4 next. If the s-bend and slalom still reach max_error at or above 0.06 m while the oval holds 20/20, the next single step is kd 1.0, with everything else fixed.
requested_changes: If the oval falls below 20/20 finishes or its steering_oscillation rises well above 0.18 (iteration 5), return controller.kd to 0.7 and test controller.kp at 1.4 with base_speed 1.1, since kd 0.7 kept the oval at 20/20.

If the s-bend or slalom still reach max_error at or above 0.06 m while the oval holds 20/20, raise controller.kd from 0.9 to 1.0 with everything else fixed, since s-bend max_error stayed at 0.060 to 0.063 across speeds 1.3, 1.1 and 1.0 and kd 0.5 to 0.7 gave the first bend gain (iteration 3 to 5).

Keep geometry.sensor_positions at the iteration 3 and 5 layout (x -0.06 to +0.06 in 0.03 m steps, y 0.05, sensor_size 0.012). The iteration 2 change to 0.04 m spacing and y 0.07 scored 62.76 with 2.8 line-loss events on the oval.
